Success criteria: The bowl is on the round plate, close to it in left-right and front-back position, and lowered near the plate surface. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a rim section facing left in the image and away from the round plate, with one finger inside and one outside. Seat the pads on the inner and outer walls below the rim to reduce slipping from gripping only the smooth narrow edge.
- Match the gripper opening to the bowl wall and room for the fingers to enter. Before closing, confirm both fingers are truly on the inside and outside of the wall, avoiding an empty grasp or pressing the rim based only on image overlap.
- Keep the bowl opening upward during transport and move its bottom over the round plate rim before approaching the plate surface, reducing tilt caused by contact with the rim.
- Lower slowly during placement while keeping clearance between the outer finger and plate. Release only after the bowl bottom is supported by the plate, avoiding the finger hitting the plate first or dropping the bowl while unsupported.
